notes.title: Update v1.1.6 / v1.1.6.1 (Mostly Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
FEATURES:
- Tweaked some of the lighting, some more dramatically than others
- The sewer gate is now no longer a literal gate
- Moved some of the content around
- Made the game a little easier to see
- QTEs are a little easier

FIXED SOME CRUCIAL GAME-BREAKING BUGS:
- When completing the first conversation in the first area, the game wouldn't continue and you'd be softlocked
- When inputting the 3 batteries in the sewer area the gate wouldn't open, also softlocking you
